title: 7 漂亮网友，张佳乐
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

17L：有就有了呗，都竞男了。

18L：认真说，有钱又帅会打游戏还有名气，不缺嫂子不也正常。

19L：又不是跟叶秋谈，叶粉这也要管？

20L：你别说，真别说，那图特别糊说不定还真是叶秋。

21L：传下去，孙翔手机壁纸是叶秋。

22L：你的意思是俩人朝夕相处，朝夕相对，同床共枕？绿色青蛙伸脚大叫卧槽恶俗哇。

23L：呵呵陶轩知道你们同意孙翔找嫂子吗？老登花大价钱找孙翔过来是想吃梦女的吧，眼红周泽楷眼红得两只小眼都要滴血了吧。

24L：主要那图确实有点……而且还是在发布会现场，正全网直播着呢，陶轩人模狗样的在那儿欢迎孙翔加入嘉世。

孙翔手机一直放在桌面上，有人给他发消息，屏幕亮了一下，刚好就被人截图下来，事后各种放大修复画质到处识图，都没找到原图。

本身这个构图就挺独特的，很有点男友视角那个味儿，应该就是谈嫂子了没错了。

25L：孙翔之前在越云的时候不一直是单身吗？这也没过几天啊。

26L：能说吗，孙翔长的也不像是很缺女朋友的样子，他看起来就是会玩爱玩的那种潮男，唐昊看起来都比他不近女色点。

27L：不近女色是什么鬼形容？但没错，我们糖糕就是一个性张力拉满的暴力和尚呀。

28L：谈恋爱也不是什么大事吧，电子竞技主要不还是看成绩，孙翔出道一年半，这战绩也不菜啊。

29L：你这得看跟谁比，叶粉也承认孙翔不菜，但是距离接手一叶之秋还差点意思吧，然后非但没有头悬梁锥刺股，甚至还敢谈恋爱，这还有啥说的，迎接风暴吧。

30L：我不行了，实名区打翻天了，叶粉举着那张照片大喊孙翔不配，恋爱脑滚出嘉世，孙翔粉丝说正主都退役了，现在跳出来是嫉妒小年轻正当打之年吗，乐子人说别吵了，孙翔壁纸其实是叶秋，翔粉叶粉请接吻。

然后突然嘉世内部工作人员匿名出来爆料，放出来了孙翔报道第一天跟叶秋的对话录音……

31L：哈哈哈哈哈哈大爷的我笑十分钟了，抱一丝啊叶鸽，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！我看翔哥你也是个人才。

32L：抱皇。）

33L：一孙之翔。

34L：翔（重音）

35L：已经没有人在意恋爱不恋爱了，即将到达战场的是你游十年恶霸叶粉姐姐（暴怒版）

36L：这还有啥说的，直接看战绩呗。下把打的差直接丧失呼吸权。

刘皓心情完全是卧槽的。

叶秋走了，他心里短暂地爽了一把，然后就被孙翔搞出来的一堆事整得焦头烂额。

最开始只是因为一张照片。

孙翔的手机壁纸。

刘皓见过那张照片。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

17L: That’s all right, they’re all competing for men.

18L: Seriously, if you are rich, handsome, good at playing games and famous, it is normal to have a sister-in-law.

19L: It’s not like you’re talking to Ye Qiu, why should Ye Fen take care of this?

20L: Don’t tell me, really don’t tell me, that picture is so confusing, maybe it’s actually Ye Qiu.

21L: Pass on, Sun Xiang’s mobile phone wallpaper is Ye Qiu.

22L: Do you mean that two people get along day and night, face each other day and night, and sleep in the same bed?The green frog stretched out its legs and shouted, "Fuck, that's vulgar."

23L: Haha, does Tao Xuan know that you agree with Sun Xiang looking for a sister-in-law?Lao Deng paid a lot of money to find Sun Xiang because he wanted to eat Mengnu. Zhou Zekai was so jealous that his little eyes were bleeding.

24L: Mainly, the picture is indeed a bit... and it is still at the press conference, which is being broadcast live on the entire network. Tao Xuan is there looking like a dog to welcome Sun Xiang to join Excellent Era.

Sun Xiang's cell phone was always on the table. Someone sent him a message. The screen lit up for a moment, and someone just took a screenshot. Afterwards, he zoomed in and repaired the image and looked around for the picture, but he couldn't find the original picture.

The composition itself is quite unique. It has a bit of a boyfriend’s perspective. It should be about talking about my sister-in-law.

25L: Wasn’t Sun Xiang always single when he was in Yueyun?It's only been a few days.

26L: Can you tell me, Sun Xiang doesn’t look like he’s in need of a girlfriend. He seems to be the kind of trendy guy who loves to have fun. Tang Hao seems to be less of a womanizer than him.

27L: What the hell does not being close to women mean?But yes, our sugar cake is a violent monk full of sexual tension.

28L: Falling in love is not a big deal, right? E-sports is not mainly about performance. Sun Xiang has been in the game for a year and a half, and his performance is not good at all.

29L: It depends on who you are competing with. Ye Fan also admits that Sun Xiang is not good at it, but he is still close to taking over One Autumn Leaf. And not only does he have no head, but he even dares to fall in love. What else can I say? Let’s face the storm.

30L: I can’t do it anymore. The real-name area is shaking things up. Ye Fan holds up the photo and shouts that Sun Xiang is unworthy. Get out of Excellent Era. Fans of Sun Xiang say that the real owner has retired. Are they jealous of the young man in his prime? People from Lezi say stop arguing. Sun Xiang’s wallpaper is actually Ye Qiu. Please kiss Xiang Fan and Ye Fan.

Then suddenly, internal staff of Excellent Era anonymously broke the news and released the recording of Sun Xiang's conversation with Ye Qiu on the first day of reporting...

31L: Hahahahaha, uncle, I’ve been laughing for ten minutes, give me a hug, Ye Ge, hahahahahaha!I think Brother Xiang, you are also a talent.

32L: Hold the emperor.)

33L: Yi Sun Zhixiang.

34L: Xiang (accent)

35L: No one cares about being in love or not. The one who is about to arrive on the battlefield is your sister Ye Fen, the bully who has been playing for ten years (wrathful version)

36L: What else can I say? Let’s just look at the results.If you hit him badly, you will lose the right to breathe.

Liu Hao was in a completely miserable mood.

Ye Qiu left, and he felt briefly relieved, but then he was troubled by all the things Sun Xiang had done.

It started with just a photo.

Sun Xiang's mobile wallpaper.

Liu Hao has seen that photo.
